reviews.title: I love this app! A few things to know tho!
reviews.text: Focus Plant is a great app for keeping off screentime, and has a bunch of great features! I love the sleep setting as a person who stays up wayyy to late on my phone, and the timers are great for reading and study sessions…but there are a few bugs that I hope are sorted out…Starting off, the widget that shows you your current focus timer NEVER works! It always says “turn off struct mode, even when strict mode is off! Also, whenever I set a sleep focus, it immediately sets off my alarm, no matter what time it is, and usually multiple times, which is annoying and makes no sense. And after plants reach level seven, I just cant water them anymore?? Its really frustrating having too many raindrops to do anything with then raise OTHER PLANTS to level 7. Otherwise, its really great and I recommend it for anyone looking to lower their screentime!

reviews.title: More of a game than a focus app
reviews.text: This app is growing on me. Be prepared that it’s more of a game than a strict focus tool. It has a timer, you get points from successfully focusing for that time, and then you can buy trees and stuff. I thought I’d be able to pick what tree I grow but that’s not the case. There’s a lot of random gifts you get for completing “tasks” that I don’t understand either. Honestly, a lot of the features seem to be distracting. So if you want a more gamified version of Flora (my original pomodoro timer) it could be fun for you. I’m waiting to save enough water drops (points) to open a group with my friend and then we’ll see what that’s like.

reviews.title: Fun little helper
reviews.text: I’m in college and have ADHD so I try to find as many hacks as I can to minimize distractions and this has been my favorite phone lock app I’ve tried so far! The reward of getting water drops to tend to my garden with gives me just the right amount of motivation to not turn off the lock timer. At first the game moves very quickly and it doesn’t take much water to plant things but after you play a few days the water drops needed for plants goes way up so you know you need to keep the timer going if you want to level up. Highly recommend!
